directive.exactQuestion: Does the coexistence of strong sales/order growth and lower year-over-year reported segment margin constitute an unresolved material contradiction that should independently block ETN, or is it a disclosed execution/mix risk that can be carried non-gating while Council Alpha completes source-addressed underwriting?
directive.whyItMatters: The workgraph currently routes unresolved_material_contradiction to Deep Resolver even though the packet's own disposition says the margin issue is a material caution but not a blocker. Leaving that semantic mismatch unresolved creates repeated resolver work without changing the factual record.
directive.preferredEvidencePath: Existing primary Eaton Q2 2026 results already in packet lineage, plus the structured Scout/Beta evidence that distinguishes demand/backlog strength from margin/integration execution risk.
lawfulFallbacks: issuer SEC filing for the same reporting period if a factual conflict in the release is identified
independent current reporting only if primary materials disagree or omit the relevant margin fact
directive.successCondition: Classify the contradiction as resolved/non-gating or still_conflicted based on whether the two claims are mutually inconsistent rather than merely simultaneous positive and negative operating facts.

observed.claimA: Strong sales/order growth suggests operating leverage potential.
observed.claimB: Reported segment margin was lower year over year.
observed.existingDisposition: material caution but not a blocker; monitor mix and integration as backlog converts.

adjudication.reason: The two claims are not mutually exclusive. Strong sales/order growth can coexist with lower segment margin because mix, acquisition integration, capacity ramp, project timing or cost absorption can offset operating leverage. The packet already treats this as a material caution and supplies explicit falsifiers. On the current evidence this is a risk/tradeoff, not an unresolved factual contradiction.

evidenceVsInference.evidence: Primary-source-backed growth/order/backlog strength and lower year-over-year segment margin are both preserved as observed facts in packet lineage.
evidenceVsInference.inference: Their coexistence does not itself prove either durable operating leverage or structural margin deterioration; future margin/backlog conversion remains the falsifier.

adjudication.gateImpact: Remove only unresolved_material_contradiction when deterministic reconciliation accepts this resolver disposition. Do not promote ETN while Council Alpha-owned underwriting/provenance failures remain.

antiRepeat.repeatedBlocker: ETN was repeatedly routed to Resolver despite prior structured dispositions already describing the same growth-versus-margin issue as non-blocking.
antiRepeat.failedStrategy: Repeated re-inspection of cumulative lineage without explicitly adjudicating whether the two claims are logically contradictory.
antiRepeat.changedStrategy: Apply a bounded semantic contradiction test: preserve both facts, distinguish coexistence from incompatibility, classify the issue as non-gating risk, and return remaining source-addressed underwriting work to its existing Council Alpha owner without duplicating it.

deferredDependentItems: Council Alpha source-integrity/company-underwriting/factor/score/risk/confidence work remains root-owner work and was not duplicated.
